PROJECTS 
CampusConnect: A Smart College Event Management and Deadline Notification System: 2026 
Built a MERN-stack platform to centralize student opportunities from scattered WhatsApp groups, enabling admin posting,

Loan Approval System: 2025 
A web application built using Python, Flask, HTML, CSS, and Pandas to check bank customer loan eligibility. Bank staff 
enter an account number and loan amount, and the system uses a CSV dataset to verify the user and evaluate age, income, 
and past loan history. Based on the data, it displays whether the loan is app roved or not, helping banks make quick and 
accurate loan decisions. 
Smart Dustbin: 2025 
Developed an innovative smart upgrade for existing corporation dustbins by integrating motion-activated lids, animal-proof 
internal barriers, and sensors to detect bin fullness. Programmed sensor controls using C++ on Arduino to enable real-time 
monitoring. Created a web-based alert system to notify municipal authorities when bins are full. Added an alarm feature 
that sounds when waste falls outside the bin to encourage proper disposal, enhancing public cleanliness and preventing 
animal interference without altering the original dustbin design. 
Hospital Management System: 2025 
This Hospital Management System is a Python-based desktop application that simplifies patient data handling in clinics 
and hospitals. It allows users to manage patient details, generate prescriptions, and track appointments th rough an easy-to-
use Tkinter GUI. The system improves accuracy and reduces manual effort by organizing patient information efficiently and 
providing expiry alerts for medicines.
